description: Polyphonic single biquad stage from the Surge filter bank, with nine filter types and a cutoff that tracks a volt per octave.

params.text: Picks the filter: LP and LP2B low-pass, HP high-pass, BP and BP2A band-pass, PKA peak, NOTCH, peakEQ and APF allpass.
Sets the cutoff, 13.75Hz to 18.8kHz, counted in semitones from A4 at 440Hz.
Sets the resonance, 0 to 1, with 0.707 giving the flattest response.
Sets the gain of the peakEQ filter, -24dB to 24dB; with the other eight filter types it does nothing.
Scales both inputs before the filter, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the filter, from silence to unity gain.

inputs.text: The left input into the filter; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels, and the number of channels here sets the polyphony.
The right input into the filter.
Adds to the Freq knob, one volt per octave.
Adds to the Reso knob, 0.1 per volt.
Adds to the Extra knob, which moves the peakEQ gain by 4.8dB per volt.

outputs.text: The left output of the filter.
The right output of the filter.

notes: this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
